description: Crawfish IMG_4109, IMG_4116 and IMG_4117 fail in the layout embedding with 'T-mesh node has no barycentric in source face'. The cause is upstream in the motorcycle graph (LCK21a §3): a trace runs into itself (a fold-back cycle), leaving a node with two ports leaving in the same direction, and the embedding then cannot place that node. Context: since CRAW-141, CRAW-142, MESH-97, CRAW-146 and CRAW-144 landed, crawfish IMG_4111, 4112 and 4118 finish quad_layout; the rest fail in separate places (IMG_4113 is the quantization stall, CRAW-147). The CRAW-144 agent diagnosed this one; its diagnostics folder went with its worktree at land, so re-measure first.
definition-of-done:
1. On each of the three scans the self-meeting trace, the node and its ports are shown (numbers and an engine screenshot of the trace under tmp/), with why LCK21a §3's stopping rule lets it happen.
2. A fix following the paper the stage implements (read it first, start from the papers: list ixd wt new prints), not a workaround stage, and the scan(s) get past this stage: report the furthest quad_layout stage before and after, with an engine screenshot if the layout finishes.
3. A unit test with a hand-made fixture, failing on master and passing after.
4. The 11 quad-layout suite models and the T-Rex skull are unchanged (same quad, patch and cone counts) and ixd wt perf shows no regression.
testing-plan:
1. Reproduce on the named crawfish scan(s) on current master with load_mesh -> repair_mesh -> quad_layout(alpha_degrees=15.0, target_edge_length=1.0), saving the failure, the stage times and the diagnostic numbers under tmp/.
2. A unit test with a hand-made fixture reproducing the failure without loading a scan, failing on master and passing after.
3. After the fix: the named scans, the 11 quad-layout suite models, the T-Rex skull, ixd wt perf.
changes-made: Trace.recordMeeting runs the LCK21a §3 stop test at a self-crossing too (it returned early but kept the entry, so a later meeting killed the trace behind its head with no end node; chain then ended on the self-crossing again: two ports in one direction). ArcNetwork.assemble picks a patch's first corner from the arc it walks on to, so a patch closing on a two-arc loop round a valence-1 cone assembles. mcg-exam opens DSL graph models (e.g. a repair DSL). Test SelfCrossingStopTest. Crawfish 4109/4116/4117 now reach contract (zero-arc collapse). Suite: block, elk, feline, hand quad counts change (feline patches 1531->1497, ILP objective lower or equal); skull unchanged.
review-summary:
The motorcycle graph's stopping test (Trace) now counts a trace crossing its own trail when the crossing happens, as LCK21a §3 does.
Deferring it stopped such traces later with no node at their end, leaving a node with two ports in one direction that the embedding could not place.
